name: t2d_beta_recovery
description: Phase 1 base for the non-inferiority gate work: recover corrected-beta magnitude. Identical to t2d_bottomline_mouse_msigdb except --write-gibbs-global-filtered-summaries, which adds beta_global_filtered / beta_uncorrected_global_filtered columns so ONE run reports gate 3 under both summary modes. Gate 3 (gene sets with beta > 0.1) is 13 here against the validated reference's 26, a -50% miss on a -10% floor, while the marginals are stronger than the reference -- so the corrected beta summarisation is the suspect. Arms are applied on top with --set.
